planner: USSR (R-5M missiles deployed at Vogelsang and Fürstenberg, GDR, 1959)
source_doc: S. Evans, 'A Soviet missile base in Germany that spy planes never saw', BBC News, 26 Oct 2012 (journalistic secondary; refers to research published in the US in 2001 = Uhl & Ivkin, CWIHP Bulletin 12/13, not obtained)
quote: Soviet nuclear missiles 20 times more powerful than Hiroshima were set up here, primed to be fired at targets including London and nuclear bases in eastern England.
notes: SECONDARY (journalism). Only named target in any accessible text on the 1959 R-5M ('Operation Atom') deployment; 'nuclear bases in eastern England' is a class. de.wikipedia 'R-5 (Rakete)' (citing Uhl, Stalins V-2, 2001, pp.236-245) gives classes only: airbases and ports in FRG, NL, BE; US missile sites in UK. 2 bases x 6 missiles per BBC.
